question.text: Under Regulation 91F of SEBI (LODR) Regulations 2015, a listed Not-for-Profit Organization is required to submit a statement of utilisation of ZCZP proceeds to the Social Stock Exchange at what frequency?

explanation.text: The Logic: Regulation 91F(1) mandates a QUARTERLY statement with three line-items: (a) category-wise amount of monies raised, (b) category-wise amount of monies utilised, (c) balance amount remaining unutilised. The unutilised portion must be kept in a separate bank account (Reg 91F(2)) and the filings continue till the issue proceeds are fully utilised or the purpose is achieved (91F(3)). The Trap: Annual filing does not satisfy 91F. Monthly / half-yearly are not 91F frequencies. The quarterly rhythm is unique to this regulation. Cross-Exam Context: III-A/III-C tests quarterly compliance cycles for listed equity/debt; XXIII imports that rhythm to ZCZP SSE filings under 91F. Assessor's Pro-Tip: During the AIR engagement, tick four quarterly 91F statements for the reporting year back-to-back and tie the balance to the separate bank account confirmation. Any co-mingling with general funds is a reportable deviation in the SIA's report.
